facts.text: The global AI in education market size was calculated at USD 7.05 billion in 2025 and is predicted to surpass around USD 136.79 billion by 2035, expanding at a strong CAGR of 34.52% from 2026 to 2035.
The growing penetration of high-speed internet and the strong development of customized learning paths increases adoption of EdTech.

The U.S. market is growing rapidly, with strong demand for personalized learning and adaptive platforms that tailor content to individual student needs, driving investments and adoption in K-12 and higher education institutions.

Market forecasts show significant expansion in market value over the coming decade, supported by robust growth rates as schools and EdTech companies integrate AI-driven tools for analytics, tutoring, and automated assessments.
The learning platform and virtual facilitators segment held the largest revenue share in the market in 2025.

It offers benefits like automated assessment, administrative efficiency, immersive learning experiences, boosts engagement, 24/7 support, enhanced accessibility, improves educational material, and 24/7 tutoring.

National Education Policy (NEP) 2020 (India) : This policy mandates the integration of AI-related subjects like digital literacy and coding across all school levels to prepare students for a tech-driven economy.
Major technology companies, including Tencent, Alibaba Group, and Baidu, are investing heavily in AI-powered tutoring platforms, adaptive learning systems, and intelligent assessment tools.
Amid this shift, Coursera, a global online learning platform, has emerged as a leader in adapting to Vietnam’s rapidly changing tech landscape.

Greg Hart, CEO of Coursera, noted that the platform currently has about 1.8 million learners in Vietnam, ranking third in Southeast Asia behind the Philippines (2.8 million) and Indonesia (2.1 million).
Vietnamese users are particularly drawn to data science, AI, and Chinese language courses.
Despite its vast potential, Vietnam’s edtech market faces hurdles such as affordability, users’ preference for free or partially paid models, and the challenge of retaining learners long-term.

However, national digital transformation policies, AI development commitments, and efforts to popularize digital skills in education are creating tangible growth opportunities for market participants.
Many have integrated livestream classes, support teachers, 24/7 learning chatbots, and exam prep content aligned with Vietnam’s national education curriculum.
These domestic players have a deep understanding of local student and parent psychology – a decisive advantage in a cost-sensitive and trust-driven market.
Vietnam’s online education sector is shifting from a “tech pilot” phase to a “content and experience strategy” phase.
This surge is fueled not only by the digital transformation of education but also by remote work trends and the need for lifelong learning in the face of rapidly evolving labor market demands.
Local edtech start-ups like Vuihoc.vn, Edupia, Moon.vn, and Topica are also accelerating, investing in AI and adaptive learning models that personalize learning progress for individual students.
The widespread impact of artificial intelligence (AI), especially generative models like ChatGPT, has dramatically transformed industries, and education is among the first to feel the change.

Market Size and Projected Expansion of the AI-Powered Personalized Learning and EdTech Tutoring Platforms Market The market for AI-driven personalized learning and EdTech tutoring platforms has experienced remarkable expansion recently.
It is projected to grow from $8.08 billion in 2025 to $10.03 billion in 2026, reflecting a strong compound annual growth rate (CAGR) of 24.0%.

This surge is largely attributed to widespread adoption of digital education tools, improved internet access facilitating online learning, heightened demand for customized educational experiences, the expansion of e-learning offerings in academic institutions, and growing investments in education technology solutions.

LONDON, GREATER LONDON, UNITED KINGDOM, October 12, 2026 / EINPresswire.com / -- The landscape of education technology is rapidly evolving, with artificial intelligence (AI) playing a pivotal role in transforming personalized learning experiences.
This overview delves into the current market status, growth drivers, regional dynamics, and key trends shaping this innovative sector.
These systems dynamically adjust instructional materials, learning speed, and assessments to suit individual needs while offering intelligent guidance and feedback.
By leveraging data-driven insights and automated support, these platforms enhance educational outcomes through continuous optimization of the learning process.
Personalized learning involves crafting educational paths, content, and assessments tailored to each learner’s unique preferences, abilities, and progress.
This demand has surged alongside the rapid integration of digital learning technologies that support adaptive, student-centered education models.

AI-powered platforms harness machine learning algorithms to provide customized lessons, intelligent tutoring, performance monitoring, and immediate feedback, catering to individual learner requirements.

The market analysis encompasses various geographical areas including Asia-Pacific, South East Asia, Western Europe, Eastern Europe, North America, South America, the Middle East, and Africa, offering a detailed global perspective on market trends and expansion opportunities.

Key trends anticipated during the forecast period involve the adoption of personalized learning path generation, real-time learner performance analytics, adaptive assessment technologies, intelligent student engagement and feedback mechanisms, as well as platforms designed to automate learning outcome optimization.
Such evidence highlights the growing appreciation and demand for personalized education solutions, which in turn fuels market growth.
